title: Midnight Street Chef

selected_categories.reasoning: The entire interaction loop is framed as preparing food, building stock, and serving customers from a street-food stall.
The player's primary repeated action is tapping a single button to fill a progress meter and generate output.
The game simulates running a small food business and earning money from customers, though it lacks deeper upgrade or expansion systems.
Taps indirectly convert into cash through a short production-to-sale loop, making score accumulation a major motivator.
The player must maintain enough cooked stock to satisfy incoming customers before their patience expires.
